title: Passing tests is not passing the gate

body.signal: A candidate that satisfies the test suite yet is behaviorally or performance-worse than its baseline.
body.failure_mode: In phase0's search stages, 128 of 368 passing candidates (46 percent) were worse than baseline on held-out ops; tests alone would have accepted most regressions.
body.detection: Never accept on tests alone: require the differential-equivalence gate for behavior and the objective ops/structure score for non-regression, both inside the locked-down container.
body.fix_strategy: Keep the never-worse rule: a candidate that fails the comparison against its baseline is rejected regardless of test status; return the baseline if nothing beats it.
